decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC sit close to the core heat-transfer business, and the certification investment makes withdrawal one year after launch unlikely, even though the product is only briefly mentioned online.
The marine box cooler system is described as holding a major market share in water cooling systems, which signals a strong position worth keeping.
The marine cooling unit has its own web page and complements the established marine box cooler line, so it is likely to stay.
The compact oil cooler gets only a brief mention online and may be a niche add-on, but it fits the core competence and costs little to maintain.
The finned tube for air coolers is a core component product with its own web page, and it likely feeds the firm's own cooler production.
The enhanced heat exchanger tubes have their own web page and represent technological differentiation in the firm's core business, so they will be retained.
